question:
A shoe manufacturing company offers 3 types of discount schemes to its customers:

(i) 20% and 12%

(ii) 25% and 5%

(iii) 30% and 3%

at different stages of sales. Find the best scheme for the customer.
solution:

successive discount=-x -y + (xtimes y/100)
